# ClauseIQ

> AI-powered legal contract analysis, risk evaluation, and clause interrogation.

ClauseIQ is a full-stack web application that allows users to upload legal PDF contracts, identify commercial and legal risks, and ask questions with exact clause citations.

## Documentation
- [ClauseIQ Home](https://clauseiq01.vercel.app/): Main dashboard for document upload and analysis
- [Document History](https://clauseiq01.vercel.app/history): Contract library and review history
- [Authentication](https://clauseiq01.vercel.app/login): Sign in with email or Google OAuth

## Features
- In-memory PDF text extraction with Gemini Vision OCR fallback
- Two-stage RAG question answering with Jina AI cross-encoder reranking
- Automated risk scoring (High, Medium, Low) with mitigation advice
- Secure JWT authentication in HttpOnly cookies with cross-tab logout synchronization
